questions.question: What is the JavaScript version of `print("hi")`?
questions.explanation: console.log prints to the browser console (or the terminal, in Node.js).

questions.question: Why use `===` instead of `==` in JavaScript?
options: == does surprising automatic type conversions, like "5" == 5 being true
questions.explanation: === compares both value and type with no conversions, so it does what you expect.
